text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The one to conquer the fierce race was 
Grass Wonder!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having seized victory by giving it her 
absolute all, she couldn't find the words 
to express her deep emotion and simply 
immersed herself in the afterglow of 
triumph.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And once again, she wished to run in the 
Arima Kinen, eager to redeem her 
lackluster performance from the year 
before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Watching the three run such a fiercely 
contested race, Special Week was left at a 
loss for words. Maruzensky called out to 
her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Spurred on by Maruzensky, Special Week 
ignited a fire in her eyes and dashed off, 
driven by her surging emotions.
